certification_scope: Production Validation Steps 1-19 are cryptographically bound and revalidated before the RC decision.
Human review gates are bound to their exact reviewed revisions and review-package SHA-256 values.
Private Case material and PII are excluded from the public release evidence.
known_limitations: Reasoning certification is contract conformance on the frozen synthetic benchmark and is not a domain-wide correctness guarantee.
Historical independent reviews certify only the exact revisions and review packages to which they are cryptographically bound.
Locked evaluation results are certification-only and must not be reused for tuning, threshold selection, or corpus changes.
